notes.after: r through man, but through Jesus Christ,

notes.text: The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

notes.after: the things which I write to you, behold,
notes.text: “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

notes.after: spoken to Abraham and to his offspring.
his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba,
notes.text: Abba is a Greek spelling for the Aramaic word for “Father” or “Daddy” used in a familiar, respectful, and loving way.
